name: REACHTEN
recent: Reach Ten 宣布第二次中期股息每股1仙，并持续进行股份回购。董事经理 Chin Yu Lay 在闭市期间及场外增持股份。最新季度（2026年6月30日止）营收环比增长12.6%，净利环比大增126.0%。
notable: 宣布第二次中期单层股息每股1仙，除权日2026年12月23日，派发日2027年1月8日。
董事经理 Chin Yu Lay 于2026年11月20日以每股0.285令吉增持10万股。
公司于2026年10月至11月期间多次进行股份回购。
risks: 董事经理在闭市期间及场外进行股份交易，需留意后续持股变动。
公司持续进行股份回购，可能影响股本结构。

recent_en: Reach Ten declared a second interim dividend of 1 sen per share and continued share buybacks. Managing Director Chin Yu Lay acquired shares during the closed period and outside closed period. Latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) revenue rose 12.6% QoQ and net profit surged 126.0% QoQ.
notable_en: Declared a second interim single-tier dividend of 1 sen per share, ex-date 23 Dec 2026, payment date 8 Jan 2027.
Managing Director Chin Yu Lay acquired 100,000 shares at RM0.285 per share on 20 Nov 2026.
The company conducted multiple share buybacks during October and November 2026.
risks_en: The Managing Director traded shares during the closed period and outside closed period; subsequent shareholding changes should be monitored.
The company continues share buybacks, which may affect its share capital structure.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM27,375,000, up 12.6% QoQ and 2.2% YoY; net profit was RM18,573,000, up 126.0% QoQ and 97.1% YoY; net margin was 67.8%, higher than 33.8% in the previous quarter.
